description:
A craft artist is launching their WooCommerce store. Configure the store's payment methods as follows:

1. Enable and configure 'Direct bank transfer' (BACS) payment method:
   - Title: Direct Bank Transfer
   - Description: Make your payment directly into our bank account. Please use your Order ID as the payment reference.
   - Instructions: Payment must be received within 5 business days. Your order will be processed once funds are confirmed.
   - Add one bank account with these details:
     - Account Name: Artisan Pottery Co
     - Account Number: 12345678
     - Bank Name: First National Bank
     - Sort Code: 01-02-03
     - IBAN: US64FNBK12345678901234
     - BIC/SWIFT: FNBKUS33
   - Save changes

2. Enable and configure 'Check payments' method:
   - Title: Check Payments
   - Description: Pay by mailing a check to our studio.
   - Instructions: Please make your check payable to "Artisan Pottery Co" and mail to: 456 Clay Avenue, Portland, OR 97201. Please include your Order ID on the check memo line.
   - Save changes

3. Disable 'Cash on delivery' (it is currently enabled and must be turned off).

Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments to access these settings. You will need to click 'Manage' or the payment method name to configure details.
